subject: English
question_text: Use capitals and punctuation marks where necessary in the following text :
stimulus: the teacher said to the girl do you think that honesty is the best policy yes sir i think so said the girl then learn to be honest from your childhood thank you sir said the girl may Allah bless you said the teacher Part B : Composition (40 Marks)
guide_solution: The teacher said to the girl, "Do you think that honesty is the best policy?" "Yes, sir. I think so," said the girl. "Then, learn to be honest from your childhood." "Thank you, sir," said the girl. "May Allah bless you," said the teacher.  For Question No. 12, 13, 14 & 15, See Solution to Suggestions; Composition Part চ্যান্সেলর এসএসসি শটর্ সাজেশন্সের উত্তরমালা  106
